newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy urges quick forming of new Albania government.
newsitem.headline: Italy urges quick forming of new Albania government.

text.p: Italy called on Wednesday for the immediate formation of Albania's planned new national unity government, saying its creation was indispensable to stemming the country's armed rebellion.

Foreign Minister Lamberto Dini, who is spearheading international efforts to help end the crisis, said it was essential that the new government include all political forces and be drawn from all areas of Albania.

Albanian President Sali Berisha on Tuesday appointed Bashkim Fino of the main opposition Socialists as prime minister to succeed Aleksander Meksi of the ruling Democratic Party, who quit last month as the unrest erupted.

Fino's task will be to head an interim government of national reconciliation pending early general elections under an accord signed on Sunday by Berisha and nine opposition parties. They asked Dini to underwrite the accord.

"Italy...calls for immediate completion of the formation in Albania of the government of national reconciliation," Dini said. "This is the essential condition for ensuring full application of the accords."

He said formation of the government was an "indispensable premise" for a dialogue with rebel movements, which have taken control of a swathe of southern territory. They are demanding Berisha's resignation and a seat at all-party talks.
